questions.question: How does Psalm 23 begin?
options: The LORD is my rock and my fortress
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want
The LORD is my light and my salvation
The LORD is king, robed in his great majesty
questions.answer: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want

questions.question: Through what valley does David say he will fear no evil?
options: The valley of the shadow of death
The valley of the dry dead bones
The valley of vision and dreams
questions.answer: The valley of the shadow of death
